job.job_description:
About ZS




ZS is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond. Our most valuable asset is our people. At ZS, you will work alongside a diverse team of experts, innovators, and problem-solvers who are passionate about creating impactful solutions for patients, caregivers, consumers, and businesses worldwide.




We partner closely with our clients to develop custom strategies, analytics solutions, and technology products that drive meaningful business outcomes. If you are curious, innovative, and passionate about leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies to solve complex problems, ZS offers an environment where you can thrive and make a lasting impact.

At ZS, we celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe that our varied backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives fuel innovation and help us build stronger solutions for our clients and communities.




About the Role




The ZS India Capability & Expertise Center (CEC) houses more than 60% of ZS professionals across offices in New Delhi, Pune, and Bengaluru. Our teams collaborate with colleagues across North America, Europe, and East Asia to deliver innovative solutions for global clients.

As a Senior LLM Engineer, you will be part of ZS's Scaled AI Practice, working at the forefront of Generative AI innovation. You will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade GenAI applications while collaborating with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to solve high-value business problems using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern AI infrastructure.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop enterprise-scale Generative AI applications such as:

Question Answering Systems
AI Search and Retrieval Engines
Information Extraction Solutions
Content Generation and Authoring Platforms
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using frameworks such as:

LangChain
LlamaIndex
Work with Large Language Models including:

Azure OpenAI
OpenAI Models
GPT-based architectures
Engineer, evaluate, and optimize prompts using techniques such as:

Zero-shot prompting
Few-shot prompting
Contextual prompting
Chain-of-thought methodologies
Design and implement GenAI application architecture including:

Vector Databases
Embedding Models
Chunking Strategies
Caching Layers
Retrieval Systems
Develop scalable, secure, and production-grade AI solutions capable of supporting:

Large user bases
High-volume datasets
Low-latency response requirements
Collaborate with Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Business teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions.

Contribute to AI platform development, deployment automation, and best practices across the complete AI/ML lifecycle.


Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in Python.

Experience developing Generative AI applications using:

Azure OpenAI
LangChain
LlamaIndex
Vector Databases
Experience with cloud platforms:

Azure (preferred)
AWS
GCP
Strong understanding of:

Data Structures
Software Engineering Principles
System Design
Distributed Computing
Experience designing and deploying solutions on cloud-based and distributed computing platforms.

Hands-on experience with:

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Embeddings
Prompt Engineering
LLM Evaluation Frameworks
Knowledge of Machine Learning and Data Science fundamentals.


Good to Have

Experience with:

Kubernetes
Docker
CI/CD Pipelines
DevOps Practices
Experience building and scaling enterprise AI products.

Familiarity with MLOps or LLMOps practices.

Experience monitoring, evaluating, and optimizing production AI systems.


Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field.

Demonstrated experience building production-grade AI/ML applications.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to learn new technologies quickly and innovate in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Why Join ZS?

Work on cutting-edge Generative AI and LLM initiatives.
Build solutions used by global Fortune 500 clients.
Collaborate with world-class AI, Data Science, and Engineering teams.
Accelerate your career in one of the industry's most advanced AI ecosystems.
Thrive in a culture that values innovation, learning, diversity, and impact.
